title: "Examples"

## Minimal tabs

```python
from anylumino import TabPanel, TextWidget

TabPanel(
    {
        "first": TextWidget("First child"),
        "second": TextWidget("Second child"),
    },
    titles={"first": "First", "second": "Second"},
)
```

## Add a tab after display

```python
tabs = TabPanel({"main": chart_a.widget}, titles={"main": "Main"})
tabs

tabs.add("recent", chart_b.widget, title="Recent", select=True)
```

## Chart dashboard skeleton

```python
from anylumino import CommandPalette, MenuBar, SplitPanel, TabPanel, Toolbar, VBox

actions = [
    {"id": "new-chart", "label": "New chart"},
    {"id": "fit", "label": "Fit"},
]

callbacks = {
    "new-chart": lambda _id: tabs.add("chart-2", new_chart.widget, title="Chart 2", select=True),
    "fit": lambda _id: tabs.call_owner(tabs.selected_key, "fit"),
}

toolbar = Toolbar(actions, callbacks=callbacks)
menu = MenuBar([{"label": "Chart", "items": actions}], callbacks=callbacks)
palette = CommandPalette(actions, callbacks=callbacks)

tabs = TabPanel({"chart-1": chart_1})
controls = VBox({"menu": menu, "toolbar": toolbar, "palette": palette})

SplitPanel({"controls": controls, "charts": tabs}, sizes=[0.25, 0.75])
```

## Local notebooks

The repository includes Jupytext notebooks for smoke testing:

- `notebooks/lightweight_charts_tabs.py` tests tabs and dynamic child addition.
- `notebooks/lightweight_charts_dashboard.py` exercises all layout and action
  widgets with `lightweight-charts-python`.
- `notebooks/input_controls_hbox.py` shows ipywidgets controls inside
  `ScrollBox`.
- `notebooks/itables_tabs.py` places an `itables.widget.ITable` inside a tab,
  appends rows to a pandas DataFrame, and refreshes the displayed table with
  `ITable.update(...)`.
